name: The National Agricultural Development Company
summary: The National Agricultural Development Company engages in the production of agricultural and livestock products in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. The company operates in three segments, Dairy and Foods, Agriculture, and Protein. It is also involved in the reclamation of agricultural land; food processing; and marketing, and distribution of its products. In addition, the company offers milk, cream, and dessert products; cheese, labneh, and butter; and yoghurt and Laban. Further, it provides juices and nectar; chilled, frozen, and fresh red meat, including beef, lamb, and mutton; and vegetables and olive oil.
